- Normalized comparison: trim outer whitespace and lowercase; this is a comparison aid, not proof of identity.
- No candidate rule supplied.
- No merge or winner selection performed.

Classifications

- Exact duplicate group: r1 and r3. Original email values are both "A@example.test". Account values are preserved but not compared.
- Normalized match group: r1, r2, and r3. Transformed email for each is "a@example.test". r2 differs from r1/r3 in original outer whitespace and case-normalized form; normalization does not establish identity.
- r4: unresolved for matching against the non-null email group because email is null. It is not classified as a duplicate or non-match on identity grounds.

- r2: email=" a@example.test ", account="u2"; normalized email="a@example.test".
- r3: email="A@example.test", account="u3"; normalized email="a@example.test".

The distinct account values are preserved and were not used to select a winner. No identity conclusion, canonical record, merge, deletion, or remediation was performed.
